```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 7
)
```

## Data

ddPCR measurements of Y-linked copy number relative to an X-linked or autosomal reference gene.
Ratio formula: **(Y+ + X+Y) / (Y– + X+Y)** where ~0.5 indicates one Y copy per diploid genome.

Filters: Screen = FALSE (regular experiments only), Pool samples only (no clones), cell lines A549, HT1080, LNCAP, HEPG2.

```{r load-data}
data_path <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/summary_table_ddPCR_edit.csv"
raw <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r classify}
CELL_LINES  <- c("A549", "HT1080", "LNCAP", "HEPG2")
GUIDE_LEVELS <- c("None", "CTRL1", "CTRL2", "CP", "Q53",
                  "CP+Q53", "CP+Q53+P47")

df <- raw %>%
  filter(
    cell_line    %in% CELL_LINES,
    Clone_or_pool == "Pool",
    Screen == FALSE | (Screen == TRUE & grepl("D0", name, ignore.case = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    probe_arm = case_when(
      TargetName %in% c("AMELY", "AMELX") ~ "Yp (AMELY/AMELX)",
      TargetName %in% c("DDX3Y", "KDM5D") ~ "Yq (DDX3Y or KDM5D/RNaseP)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Parental (Guides == "None") is always 0 nucleofections regardless of CSV value
    Nucelofections = if_else(Guides == "None", 0L, as.integer(Nucelofections)),
    Guides        = factor(Guides, levels = GUIDE_LEVELS),
    Nucelofections = factor(Nucelofections, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                            labels = c("0 (Parental)", "1\u00d7", "2\u00d7")),
    cell_line     = factor(cell_line, levels = CELL_LINES)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(probe_arm), !is.na(Guides))
```

Points per group:

```{r counts-table}
df %>%
  count(cell_line, Guides, Nucelofections, probe_arm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = probe_arm, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(cell_line, Guides, Nucelofections) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## LOY KO Effectiveness

```{r main-figure, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
NUCL_COLORS <- c("0 (Parental)" = "#999999",
                 "1\u00d7"       = "#4DBBD5",
                 "2\u00d7"       = "#E64B35")

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Guides, y = ratio,
                    fill = Nucelofections,
                    group = Nucelofections)) +
  # ── Reference line at 0.5 (normal male XY) ──────────────────────────────────
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # ── Bars (mean) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar",
               position = pd, width = 0.65,
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # ── Error bars (±1 SD) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1),
               geom = "errorbar",
               position = pd, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # ── Probe arm (row) × cell line (column) panels ──────────────────────────────
  facet_grid(probe_arm ~ cell_line, scales = "free_x") +
  # ── Scales ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  scale_fill_manual(values = NUCL_COLORS, name = "Nucleofections") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.35),
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  # ── Labels ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  labs(
    x = "Guide RNA",
    y = "Y-linked : Reference Gene Ratio (ddPCR)"
  ) +
  # ── Theme ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    panel.border      = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 9, color = "black",
                                     angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin       = margin(t = 8, r = 12, b = 8, l = 8)
  )

print(p)

out_base <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/code/LOY_effectiveness_figure"
ggsave(paste0(out_base, ".pdf"), p, width = 12, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(paste0(out_base, ".png"), p, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
message("Saved: ", out_base, ".pdf / .png")
```

*Top row = Yp arm (AMELY/AMELX); bottom row = Yq arm (DDX3Y or KDM5D/RNaseP). Bar height = mean ratio; error bars = ±1 SD. Fill color = nucleofection rounds (grey = 0/Parental, blue = 1×, red = 2×). Dashed line at 0.5 = expected ratio for one Y copy per diploid genome.*

## % Y Chromosome Reduction vs CTRL

Each nucleofection level is compared to its matched CTRL (1× KO vs 1× CTRL; 2× KO vs 2× CTRL). If no 2× CTRL exists for a cell line, the 1× CTRL mean is used as baseline. LOY KO guides: CP+Q53 (A549, HT1080) and CP+Q53+P47 (LNCAP, HEPG2).

```{r reduction-figure, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ARM_COLORS <- c("Yp (AMELY/AMELX)"           = "#E64B35",
                "Yq (DDX3Y or KDM5D/RNaseP)" = "#3C5488")

CTRL_GUIDES <- c("CTRL1", "CTRL2")
KO_GUIDES   <- c("CP+Q53", "CP+Q53+P47")

ctrl_means <- df %>%
  filter(as.character(Guides) %in% CTRL_GUIDES) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, Nucelofections, probe_arm) %>%
  summarise(ctrl_mean = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ctrl_1x <- ctrl_means %>%
  filter(Nucelofections == "1\u00d7") %>%
  select(cell_line, probe_arm, ctrl_mean_1x = ctrl_mean)

ko_means <- df %>%
  filter(as.character(Guides) %in% KO_GUIDES) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, Nucelofections, probe_arm) %>%
  summarise(ko_mean = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

reduction <- ko_means %>%
  left_join(ctrl_means, by = c("cell_line", "Nucelofections", "probe_arm")) %>%
  left_join(ctrl_1x,   by = c("cell_line", "probe_arm")) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline      = coalesce(ctrl_mean, ctrl_mean_1x),
    pct_reduction = pmax((baseline - ko_mean) / baseline * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pct_reduction),
         Nucelofections %in% c("1\u00d7", "2\u00d7"))

reduction_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 11)
  )

make_reduction_plot <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = cell_line, y = pct_reduction, fill = probe_arm)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.60,
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct_reduction, 1), "%"),
                  y     = pct_reduction + 1.5),
              position  = position_dodge(0.75),
              vjust = 0, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
    facet_wrap(~Nucelofections, nrow = 1,
               labeller = labeller(
                 Nucelofections = c("1\u00d7" = "1\u00d7 Nucleofection",
                                    "2\u00d7" = "2\u00d7 Nucleofections"))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ARM_COLORS) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 115), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% Reduction vs CTRL", fill = "Probe Locus") +
    reduction_theme
}

p2 <- make_reduction_plot(reduction)
print(p2)

out_base2 <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/code/LOY_reduction_figure"
ggsave(paste0(out_base2, ".pdf"), p2, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(paste0(out_base2, ".png"), p2, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
message("Saved: ", out_base2, ".pdf / .png")
```

*% reduction = (mean CTRL ratio − mean LOY KO ratio) / mean CTRL ratio × 100.*

## Summary Table

Mean ± SD ratio per cell line × guide RNA × nucleofections × probe arm.

```{r summary-table}
df %>%
  group_by(cell_line, Guides, Nucelofections, probe_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    mean_ratio = round(mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_ratio   = round(sd(ratio,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    min_ratio  = round(min(ratio,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    max_ratio  = round(max(ratio,  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Cell Line`      = cell_line,
    `Guide RNA`      = Guides,
    `Nucleofections` = Nucelofections,
    `Probe Arm`      = probe_arm,
    `n`              = n,
    `Mean Ratio`     = mean_ratio,
    `SD`             = sd_ratio,
    `Min`            = min_ratio,
    `Max`            = max_ratio
  ) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options  = list(pageLength = 50, dom = "t"),
    class    = "compact"
  )
```

## HEPG2 & LNCAP — Effectiveness

```{r hl-figure, fig.width=6, fig.height=7}
HL_LINES <- c("LNCAP", "HEPG2")
df_hl    <- df %>% filter(cell_line %in% HL_LINES)

p_hl <- ggplot(df_hl, aes(x = Guides, y = ratio,
                           fill = Nucelofections,
                           group = Nucelofections)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar",
               position = pd, width = 0.65,
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1),
               geom = "errorbar",
               position = pd, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(probe_arm ~ cell_line, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = NUCL_COLORS, name = "Nucleofections") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.35),
                     breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Guide RNA", y = "Y-linked : Reference Gene Ratio (ddPCR)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 9, color = "black", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin      = margin(t = 8, r = 12, b = 8, l = 8)
  )

print(p_hl)

out_hl <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/code/LOY_effectiveness_HEPG2_LNCAP"
ggsave(paste0(out_hl, ".pdf"), p_hl, width = 6, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(paste0(out_hl, ".png"), p_hl, width = 6, height = 7, dpi = 300)
message("Saved: ", out_hl, ".pdf / .png")
```

## HEPG2 & LNCAP — % Reduction

```{r hl-reduction, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
ctrl_means_hl <- df_hl %>%
  filter(as.character(Guides) %in% CTRL_GUIDES) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, Nucelofections, probe_arm) %>%
  summarise(ctrl_mean = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ctrl_1x_hl <- ctrl_means_hl %>%
  filter(Nucelofections == "1\u00d7") %>%
  select(cell_line, probe_arm, ctrl_mean_1x = ctrl_mean)

ko_means_hl <- df_hl %>%
  filter(as.character(Guides) %in% KO_GUIDES) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, Nucelofections, probe_arm) %>%
  summarise(ko_mean = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

reduction_hl <- ko_means_hl %>%
  left_join(ctrl_means_hl, by = c("cell_line", "Nucelofections", "probe_arm")) %>%
  left_join(ctrl_1x_hl,   by = c("cell_line", "probe_arm")) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline      = coalesce(ctrl_mean, ctrl_mean_1x),
    pct_reduction = pmax((baseline - ko_mean) / baseline * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pct_reduction),
         Nucelofections %in% c("1\u00d7", "2\u00d7"))

p_hl2 <- make_reduction_plot(reduction_hl)
print(p_hl2)

out_hl2 <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/code/LOY_reduction_HEPG2_LNCAP"
ggsave(paste0(out_hl2, ".pdf"), p_hl2, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(paste0(out_hl2, ".png"), p_hl2, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
message("Saved: ", out_hl2, ".pdf / .png")
```
